author: Loxy Systems
description: Egg Open-MP para Pterodactyl usando config.json como configuracao principal. server.cfg nao e obrigatorio. Runtime Debian 12 com i386, reparo automatico do omp-server sem usar /tmp e startup remoto da Loxy Systems.

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
set -Eeuo pipefail
export DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive

SERVER_DIR="/mnt/server"
REPO="openmultiplayer/open.mp"
VERSION="${VERSION:-latest}"
TMP_DIR="${SERVER_DIR}/.loxy-openmp-install"
cleanup(){ rm -rf "${TMP_DIR}"; }
trap cleanup EXIT

rm -rf "${TMP_DIR}"
mkdir -p "${TMP_DIR}/extract" "${SERVER_DIR}"

echo '=================================================='
echo '      Open-MP Installer - Loxy Systems v2.5'
echo '=================================================='

echo '[1/6] Instalando dependencias...'
apt-get update
apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends ca-certificates curl jq tar file
rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*

echo '[2/6] Consultando release oficial do Open-MP...'
if [[ -z "${VERSION}" || "${VERSION}" == 'latest' ]]; then
    RELEASE_API="https://api.github.com/repos/${REPO}/releases/latest"
else
    RELEASE_API="https://api.github.com/repos/${REPO}/releases/tags/${VERSION}"
fi

RELEASE_JSON="$(curl -fsSL --retry 5 --retry-delay 2 -H 'Accept: application/vnd.github+json' -H 'User-Agent: Loxy-Pterodactyl-OpenMP' "${RELEASE_API}")"
RELEASE_TAG="$(printf '%s' "${RELEASE_JSON}" | jq -r '.tag_name // empty')"
DOWNLOAD_LINK="$(printf '%s' "${RELEASE_JSON}" | jq -r '.assets[]? | select(.name == "open.mp-linux-x86-dynssl.tar.gz") | .browser_download_url' | head -n1)"

if [[ -z "${DOWNLOAD_LINK}" ]]; then
    DOWNLOAD_LINK="$(printf '%s' "${RELEASE_JSON}" | jq -r '.assets[]? | select(.name == "open.mp-linux-x86.tar.gz") | .browser_download_url' | head -n1)"
fi

if [[ -z "${DOWNLOAD_LINK}" || "${DOWNLOAD_LINK}" == 'null' ]]; then
    echo '[ERRO] Asset Linux x86 do Open-MP nao encontrado.'
    exit 1
fi

echo "[3/6] Baixando Open-MP ${RELEASE_TAG}..."
curl -fL --retry 5 --retry-delay 2 -o "${TMP_DIR}/openmp.tar.gz" "${DOWNLOAD_LINK}"

echo '[4/6] Extraindo no volume do servidor...'
tar -xzf "${TMP_DIR}/openmp.tar.gz" -C "${TMP_DIR}/extract"
OMP_BINARY="$(find "${TMP_DIR}/extract" -type f -name omp-server -print -quit || true)"
[[ -n "${OMP_BINARY}" ]] || { echo '[ERRO] omp-server nao encontrado no pacote.'; exit 1; }
OMP_ROOT="$(dirname "${OMP_BINARY}")"
cp -a -n "${OMP_ROOT}/." "${SERVER_DIR}/"
chmod 755 "${SERVER_DIR}/omp-server"

# config.json e a configuracao principal. Nunca exige server.cfg.
if [[ ! -f "${SERVER_DIR}/config.json" ]]; then
    echo '[CONFIG] Gerando config.json padrao...'
    (cd "${SERVER_DIR}" && ./omp-server --default-config >/dev/null 2>&1 || true)
fi

if [[ ! -f "${SERVER_DIR}/config.json" ]]; then
    echo '[ERRO] Nao foi possivel criar config.json.'
    exit 1
fi

echo '[5/6] Ajustando config.json com as variaveis da Egg...'
MAX_PLAYERS_VALUE="${MAX_PLAYERS:-50}"
MAX_NPC_VALUE="${MAX_NPC:-0}"
QUERY_VALUE="${QUERY:-true}"
HOST_NAME_VALUE="${HOST_NAME:-Servidor Open-MP}"
WEB_URL_VALUE="${WEB_URL:-open.mp}"
RCON_PASSWORD_VALUE="${RCON_PASSWORD:-}"
SERVER_PORT_VALUE="${SERVER_PORT:-7777}"
[[ "${MAX_PLAYERS_VALUE}" =~ ^[0-9]+$ ]] || MAX_PLAYERS_VALUE=50
[[ "${MAX_NPC_VALUE}" =~ ^[0-9]+$ ]] || MAX_NPC_VALUE=0
[[ "${SERVER_PORT_VALUE}" =~ ^[0-9]+$ ]] || SERVER_PORT_VALUE=7777
[[ "${QUERY_VALUE}" == 'true' || "${QUERY_VALUE}" == 'false' ]] || QUERY_VALUE=true

TMP_CONFIG="${TMP_DIR}/config.json.tmp"
jq --arg name "${HOST_NAME_VALUE}" --arg website "${WEB_URL_VALUE}" \
   --argjson max_players "${MAX_PLAYERS_VALUE}" --argjson max_bots "${MAX_NPC_VALUE}" \
   --argjson enable_query "${QUERY_VALUE}" --argjson port "${SERVER_PORT_VALUE}" \
   --arg rcon_password "${RCON_PASSWORD_VALUE}" \
   '.name=$name | .max_players=$max_players | .max_bots=$max_bots | .website=$website | .enable_query=$enable_query | .network.port=$port | .rcon.password=$rcon_password' \
   "${SERVER_DIR}/config.json" > "${TMP_CONFIG}"
mv "${TMP_CONFIG}" "${SERVER_DIR}/config.json"

echo '[6/6] Ajustando permissoes...'
find "${SERVER_DIR}/plugins" -maxdepth 1 -type f -name '*.so' -exec chmod 755 {} \; 2>/dev/null || true
find "${SERVER_DIR}/components" -maxdepth 1 -type f -name '*.so' -exec chmod 755 {} \; 2>/dev/null || true

echo '=================================================='
echo " Instalacao concluida: Open-MP ${RELEASE_TAG}"
echo ' Configuracao: config.json'
echo ' server.cfg: NAO obrigatorio'
echo '=================================================='
